title: 2026 North Carolina Election Analysis
text:
County Voting Trends Map
The map below illustrates party vote margins across all 100 North Carolina counties for the US Senate race. Blue indicates a Democratic margin, and red indicates a Republican margin.








Figure 2: County Vote Margins in the 2026 North Carolina US Senate Race











NoteHow to Read This Map




Blue: Counties won by the Democratic candidate (higher percentages indicate larger victory margins, commonly in urban centers like Wake, Durham, and Mecklenburg).
Red: Counties won by the Republican candidate (strongest across rural counties).
White / Light Shading: Close or competitive counties where vote shares were nearly even.

title: About
text:
This project explores results from the November 3, 2026 general election in North Carolina, focusing on voter behavior and geographic voting patterns across the state.



Voting Method Comparison: Analysis of how Democrats and Republicans utilized different voting methods, including Early Voting, Election Day, and Absentee by Mail.
County-Level Trends: A choropleth map illustrating Democratic vs. Republican margins across all 100 North Carolina counties.




All election data is sourced directly from the North Carolina State Board of Elections (NCSBE).
